off.oneColumn: The selection is a single column: a column of totals on its right would only repeat each value. Use the row below instead.

totals.notFree: The cells next to the selection are not empty; clear them first.
totals.noNumbers: The selection has no numbers to total.

remoteShow.remoteHint: Scan the QR code with a phone (on the same network as the BlueOffice server) to change slides, black the screen or end the show from the phone. The code works once and expires after a few minutes.
remoteShow.expired: The code has expired — create a new one.
remoteShow.waitingPhone: Waiting for the phone to scan the code…
remoteShow.phonePaired: A phone is paired (disconnected at the moment).
remoteShow.phoneConnected: The phone is connected and in control.
remoteShow.localOnly: This address only opens on this computer. Open BlueOffice through the server’s LAN address so the phone can reach it.
remoteShow.unavailable: Remote presenting is not turned on on the BlueOffice server (or the server cannot be reached).
remoteShow.onlineHint: Viewers open the link to follow the slide and animation being shown in real time. They cannot move to other slides themselves. The current presentation is uploaded to the BlueOffice server for the people with the link.

errors.unavailable: Remote presenting is not turned on on the BlueOffice server.
errors.unauthorized: Sign in (or open the file from its document store) to present remotely.
errors.tooMany: You have too many remote presentations running at once.
errors.forbidden: This file may not be downloaded, so it cannot be presented online.
errors.tooLarge: The presentation is too large to present online.
errors.rateLimited: Too fast — try again in a minute.
errors.invalidToken: The link is not valid or has expired.

remoteShow.phoneInvalid: This pairing code is not valid, already used or expired. Scan a new code on the presenting computer.
remoteShow.phoneRevoked: The presenter revoked this phone’s control.
remoteShow.watchWaiting: The presenter has not started the slide show yet. It appears here when it starts.
remoteShow.watchInvalid: The link is not valid or the presentation has ended.
remoteShow.captionsUnavailable: Subtitles are not available: there is no speech recogniser (an administrator needs to configure dictation on the BlueOffice server, or the browser has none).
remoteShow.captionsOn: Show subtitles during the slide show
remoteShow.captionsNoTranslation: No translation service is configured, so subtitles are in the spoken language.

addins.empty: Your administrator has not published any add-in for this application.

consent.title: Install {{name}}?
consent.intro: This add-in is provided by {{publisher}} and loaded from {{origin}}. If you install it, it may:
consent.none: It needs no permission on your documents.
consent.note: You can uninstall it at any time; its data stored on this device is then deleted.

perm.readDocument: Read all content of the open document
perm.writeDocument: Change the open document (each change can be undone)
perm.selection: Read and change the selection, read the selected content
perm.ribbon: Add command buttons to the ribbon
perm.storage: Store its own data on this device

autoSum.nothing: The selection has no numbers to add up.
